title: Verify Active rule can be deployed to Development environment

steps.action: Send POST /deploy for {activeRuleId} with environment parameter set to Development and parameterized change description.
steps.expected: Response is 202 Accepted; response body contains deployment_id, rule_id, rule_code, version_number, environment=Development, deployed_at UTC, and deployed_by; deployment log is created.

title: Verify Active rule can be deployed to Staging environment

steps.action: Send POST /deploy for {activeRuleId} with environment parameter set to Staging and parameterized change description.
steps.expected: Response is 202 Accepted; response body contains deployment_id, rule_id, rule_code, version_number, environment=Staging, deployed_at UTC, and deployed_by; deployment log is created.

title: Verify Active rule can be deployed to UAT environment

steps.action: Send POST /deploy for {activeRuleId} with environment parameter set to UAT and parameterized change description.
steps.expected: Response is 202 Accepted; response body contains deployment_id, rule_id, rule_code, version_number, environment=UAT, deployed_at UTC, and deployed_by; deployment log is created.

title: Verify Active rule can be deployed to Production environment

steps.action: Send POST /deploy for {activeRuleId} with environment parameter set to Production and parameterized change description.
steps.expected: Response is 202 Accepted; response body contains deployment_id, rule_id, rule_code, version_number, environment=Production, deployed_at UTC, and deployed_by; deployment log is created.

title: Verify deployment of Draft rule is blocked

steps.action: Send POST /deploy for {{draftRuleId}}.
steps.expected: Response is 422 Unprocessable Entity; no deployment log entry is created.

title: Verify deployment of PendingApproval rule is blocked

steps.action: Send POST /deploy for {{pendingApprovalRuleId}}.
steps.expected: Response is 422 Unprocessable Entity; deployment history remains unchanged.

title: Verify deployment of Approved but not Active rule is blocked

steps.action: Send POST /deploy for {{approvedRuleId}} before activation.
steps.expected: Response is 422 Unprocessable Entity; no log is created.

title: Verify deployment of Inactive rule is blocked

steps.action: Send POST /deploy for {{inactiveRuleId}}.
steps.expected: Response is 422 Unprocessable Entity and no log entry is created.

title: Verify deployment of Retired rule is blocked

steps.action: Send POST /deploy for {{retiredRuleId}}.
steps.expected: Response is 422 Unprocessable Entity; deployment log count is unchanged.

title: Verify duplicate deployment same rule/version/environment returns conflict

steps.action: Deploy {{activeRuleId}} version {{versionNumber}} to {{environment}}, then repeat the same request.
steps.expected: Second request returns 409 Conflict with existing deployment reference; no duplicate log entry is created.

title: Verify same rule new version can deploy to same environment

steps.action: Deploy version {{versionNumber}} to {{environment}}, create/activate a new version through setup, then deploy {{newVersionNumber}} to same environment.
steps.expected: Response for new version is 202 Accepted and a separate deployment log exists with new version_number.

title: Verify invalid environment value returns 400

steps.action: Send POST /deploy with environment={{invalidEnvironmentValue}}.
steps.expected: Response is 400 Bad Request with environment validation error; no log entry is created.

title: Verify empty change_description returns 400

steps.action: Send POST /deploy with blank change_description.
steps.expected: Response is 400 Bad Request with change_description validation error.

title: Verify change_description exceeding max length returns 400

steps.action: Send POST /deploy with {{changeDescriptionMoreThan1000Chars}} generated by test data.
steps.expected: Response is 400 Bad Request with MaxLength validation error; no log is created.

title: Verify missing token on deploy returns 401

steps.action: Send POST /deploy without Authorization header.
steps.expected: Response is 401 Unauthorized and no mutation occurs.

title: Verify monitor-only token cannot deploy

steps.action: Send POST /deploy using token with rule.monitor only.
steps.expected: Response is 403 Forbidden and no deployment log is created.

title: Verify get deployment history for rule returns sorted results

steps.action: Send GET deployments for {{ruleId}} after creating multiple deployments across versions/environments.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK; all entries belong to requested rule and are sorted newest to oldest.

title: Verify deployment history supports environment filter

steps.action: Send GET /rules/deployments?environment={{validEnvironment}}.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and every returned entry has matching environment.

title: Verify get all deployments returns paginated response

steps.action: Send GET all deployments with parameterized page and page_size.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK with requested page window and accurate total_count or  metadata per contract.

title: Verify get all deployments supports page 2

steps.action: Seed more records than page_size, then request page={{secondPageNumber}} and page_size={{pageSize}}.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK; records do not duplicate page 1 and metadata reflects full result count.

title: Verify get all deployments filters by environment

steps.action: Send GET /rulesengine/deployments?environment={{validEnvironment}}.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and all entries have matching environment.

title: Verify get all deployments filters by rule_id

steps.action: Send GET /rulesengine/deployments?rule_id={{ruleId}}.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and all returned entries match requested rule_id.

title: Verify missing token on read deployments returns 401

steps.action: Send GET rule deployments and GET all deployments without Authorization header.
steps.expected: Each request returns 401 Unauthorized.
